description: Defines a custom web component 'a2ui-textfield' for rendering a text input field with label, styling, and data binding, using Lit library.

classes.name: TextField
classes.description: A custom web component extending Root, representing a styled text input with label and data binding.

methods.name: #setBoundValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the text data in the processor, updating bound data.

methods.name: #renderField
methods.description: Renders the HTML structure for the text input and label.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component by extracting label and value, then calling #renderField.
